subjects.description: A regulation red octagonal stop sign mounted on a galvanized metal post at the right corner of a four-way intersection
subjects.appearance_details: Bright red reflective face with a bold white border and the white word 'STOP' in the center; several small black-and-white rectangular stickers are scattered across the sign's surface without obscuring the octagonal shape or the lettering
subjects.relationship: The primary regulatory object the ego vehicle must detect and obey
subjects.location: Right side of frame, at the corner of the intersection
subjects.orientation: Facing the oncoming ego vehicle, angled slightly toward the camera
subjects.action: Standing at the intersection corner signaling a required stop
subjects.state_changes: No significant change; grows larger in frame as the vehicle approaches then holds steady when stopped

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car represented through its first-person dashboard/windshield point of view
subjects.appearance_details: Interior edges of the windshield frame and a faint reflection of the dashboard may be visible at the lower border; the hood is subtly present at the bottom of frame
subjects.relationship: The point-of-view vehicle navigating the street and responding to the stop sign
subjects.location: Camera position; occupies the driver's forward view
subjects.orientation: Facing forward down the residential street toward the intersection
subjects.pose: Moving forward then decelerating to a full stop
subjects.action: Driving along the street, braking smoothly, stopping at the marked line
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from steady forward motion to smooth deceleration to a complete, sustained stop

background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street lined with single-family homes, mature trees, trimmed lawns and parked cars along the curbs. The street leads to a four-way intersection with a dry, clean asphalt surface and painted white stop line at the crossing. A cross street is visible running perpendicular and is completely empty of traffic. The sky is clear blue with abundant midday sunlight. A regulation red octagonal stop sign sits on a metal post at the right corner.

lighting.direction: High front-side lighting from the upper left, consistent with midday sun
lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows cast by trees, the sign post, and parked vehicles onto the pavement and lawns
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural daylight that renders colors vividly and keeps the red of the stop sign highly saturated and clearly legible

aesthetics.composition: Symmetrical forward-facing dashcam framing with the road receding to a central vanishing point, the stop sign offset to the right and the marked stop line approaching along the lower third
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant blues of the sky, greens of foliage and lawns, neutral grays of asphalt, and the vivid red-and-white of the stop sign as the focal accent
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating rows of houses, curbside parked cars, and lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's point of view
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the road ahead, the stop sign, and the painted stop line
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Wide-angle, approximately 24mm equivalent typical of dashcam optics

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS demonstration of stop-sign recognition and compliant braking despite sign defacement

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the quiet residential street, approaching the four-way intersection with the sticker-covered stop sign visible growing on the right.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
The vehicle comes to a complete stop at the marked line and remains fully stationary for the remaining duration; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Bold white uppercase sans-serif lettering centered on a red octagonal field with a white border
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: On the sign at the right corner of the intersection, visible throughout and increasingly prominent as the vehicle approaches
text_and_signage_elements.context: Regulatory traffic sign requiring vehicles to come to a full stop; remains legible despite scattered stickers

segments.description: Forward approach down the residential street toward the intersection with the stop sign on the right.
segments.key_changes: Stop sign and stop line grow larger in frame as the vehicle advances at steady speed.
segments.camera: Smooth forward tracking motion at cruising speed.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle reaches a complete stop at the marked line and holds stationary. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward along the quiet residential street, approaching the four-way intersection with the sticker-covered stop sign visible growing on the right. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban daytime sounds: the low hum of the moving car's engine and tire noise on dry asphalt, which fades as the vehicle decelerates. Faint distant bird calls and a light breeze. A subtle brake sound accompanies the stop, followed by quiet idling once the vehicle is fully stationary. No speech or music.
